info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Customer Account Data Access Tiers API
info.description: This API enables businesses to define and manage data access tiers for customer accounts. By utilizing this endpoint, users can specify varying levels of data accessibility tailored to specific customer needs. Typical consumers include account managers and developers who oversee customer data permissions. Leveraging this API enhances data governance and ensures compliance with access policies. This operation is essential for effectively managing how data is utilized across different account types.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create data access tiers for a specific customer account. It enables you to manage and configure the data access levels according to the customer's requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to define data access tiers for the specified customer account. It should contain all necessary parameters to create or modify the data access tier settings.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
